title: A Resolvent Framework for Global and Local Nonlinear Semigroups

edge_sample.source_text: theorem The thick tower: With $A$ enumerated, set $X_k = V + \{a_j : j \geq k\}$. Then $X_k$ is decreasing (\texttt{X\_antitone}), $\bigcap_k X_k = \emptyset$ (\texttt{X\_iInter}), and every $X_k$ is thick: any measurable set disjoint from it is null.
edge_sample.target_text: theorem The trace measure on a thick set: For $X$ thick for $\mu$, the traces $\{E \cap X\}$ carry a measure with $\lambda_X(E \cap X) = \mu(E)$ (Border, Prop.~14).

edge_sample.source_text: lemma The k-cap: If $0 < L$ and $\mathrm{LISC}_k(L)$ then $k \leq |A|$.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma Unsafe is a finite union of reachability sets: For finite $A$, $\mathrm{Unsafe}(\rho)$ is the union of $\mathrm{TR}_k^{(1)}$ over $2 \leq k \leq |A|$.

edge_sample.source_text: theorem $\Psi$, in ZFC: $\Psi$ holds on $\sigma$-classes/OMPs, irreducible modulo the countable ideal, in ZFC.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma The carrier is not Polish-representable: Write $\mathrm{DWPolishCut}$ for the statement that a Polish-representable carrier admits no $\sigma$-essential witness. Granting it, $L_1$ is not Polish-representable. The hypothesis is carried explicitly.

edge_sample.target_text: definition Unsafe and Safe: $\mathrm{Unsafe}(\rho)$ is the set of $L \geq 1$ with $\mathrm{LISC}_k(L)$ for some $k \geq 2$, and $\mathrm{Safe}(\rho)$ is its complement among the positives. Ring reconstruction $C_L = R_L$ holds exactly on $\mathrm{Safe}(\rho)$.

edge_sample.target_text: theorem The carrier is MO$_2$: The indexing $\bot, a, a', b, b', \top \;\mapsto\; \emptyset, A, A^{c}, B, B^{c}, \Omega$ is a bijection onto $L$; it carries the order of MO$_2$ to inclusion and $(\cdot)^{\perp}$ to set complement.
